# HitFX

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** HitFX

## What it does

HitFX turns a successful hit on another player or mob into a little celebration. Whenever you land an attack, it can spawn particles around your target and play a fun sound effect, so combat feels more rewarding and your hits are easier to register at a glance.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/hitfx). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
